# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest [release](../../releases) is supported. Please update
before reporting an issue to confirm it's still present.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please don't open a public issue for a security vulnerability.**

GitHub's private vulnerability reporting isn't enabled on this repository
yet. Until it is, please reach out to the maintainer directly rather than
filing a public issue, so the report isn't visible before a fix is
available.
